description: Réseaux Gaz Propane - Département de l'Indre (36) is a dataset listed in SOREGIES OpenData open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by SOREGIES. Ce jeu de données représente la position des réseaux Gaz Propane sur le réseau de distribution exploité par SOREGIES sur le département de l'Indre (36). Le système de projection utilisé est le Lambert 93 (référence nationale). Les données correspondent à la vision au 01/04/2021. Ces données sont restituées sous la forme de découpage en segments. Coverage: Vienne, Vendée, Maine-et-Loire, Indre and Indre-et-Loire (SOREGIES network). The portal files it under Gaz. Its keywords are Réseaux, Gaz, Propane, Cartographie, Indre (36). The portal shows 520 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support gas network and biomethane studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-soregies-fr-portal.
